messages:
Alex: Heads-up — overnight we saw our routing engine trigger fallbacks for several enterprise customers in us-west-2 during a short spike. p95 for enterprise model variant A hit 1.2s, CB tripped and traffic moved to variant-B which increased token cost by ~25%. Need a plan: prefetch/warmup + adaptive CB windows?

Priya: Got logs? Are these requests cold-starts or KV cache misses? :thinking:

Alex: Short logs attached; looks like sequence_length median was normal but KV cache miss rate jumped to 18% for model-A. Also observed a steady 503 rate (0.7%) for ~45s which our strict CB (error_rate>0.5% over 30s) triggered on.

Sam: Re: CB thresholds — we've been running a flat 0.5% error threshold across tiers. That doesn't make sense for enterprise (SLO=99.95) vs free tier (SLO=99). Suggest tiered CB policies: lower threshold for enterprise, longer window for free tier.

Jorge: Agreed. Also think about a 'prefetch' heuristic: when a rollout or traffic shift is detected, proactively warm secondary variants with a small sampled prefix set. Could be a 1% background prefetch to reduce KV cold misses.

Maya: UX question: how should Console present CB states? We need per-customer, per-region, per-variant flags. Propose a 'circuit health' column + timebox playback and a button to force warmup.

Priya: Example config sketch:
```
routing_policy:
  tiers:
    enterprise:
      latency_slo_ms: 350
      cb_error_rate_pct: 0.2
      cb_window_s: 60
      prefetch_sample_pct: 1.0
    paid:
      latency_slo_ms: 500
      cb_error_rate_pct: 0.5
      cb_window_s: 30
      prefetch_sample_pct: 0.2
    free:
      latency_slo_ms: 1000
      cb_error_rate_pct: 1.0
      cb_window_s: 15
      prefetch_sample_pct: 0.0
```

Alex: Nice. Two follow-ups: 1) telemetry — add a 'fallthrough cost' metric showing delta token usage when fallback occurs; 2) tuning: use p95 latency + error rate combined for CB, not just errors.

Sam: For combined signal, propose CB triggers when (error_rate > threshold) OR (p95_latency > latency_slo * 2) for window. Also add a decay/backoff so the CB doesn't oscillate.

Jorge: We need a simulator to run these policies against historical traces. I can add a CLI: `tool simulate-policy --trace=2026-03-15.gz --policy=enterprise-v2` outputting estimated cost/regret vs availability.

Maya: Console idea: show predicted cost/regret curves from simulator alongside current live metrics. Helps CS explain to customers.

Priya: One gating item: KMS/keyed warmup access for private deployments. Prefetch will initiate model loads—need ACL and audit logging.

Alex: Action items:
- Jorge: prototype simulator + sample CLI (ETA 3d)
- Sam: propose DSL changes for CB + decay params (ETA 2d)
- Priya: add prefetch knobs to routing config + security checklist (ETA 4d)
- Maya: wire up Console mockups for circuit health + simulator output (ETA 5d)

deploy-bot: @channel rolling canary of routing-runtime v0.62 completed at 2026-03-15T02:14Z :white_check_mark:

Maya: Ok team — adding this to next week's eng-platform review. If no objections, we'll start with a conservative enterprise policy and 0.5% sampled prefetch.

Sam: :thumbsup: I'll update the API spec and add tests to ensure CB windowing is plumbed through.

Jorge: I'll also commit a simple simulator harness and share a quick dashboard snapshot once it's done.

Alex: Thanks everyone. Please drop short notes in the design doc: /docs/routing/prefetch-cb-design.md

Priya: One more note — include rollback hooks so we can disable prefetch via feature flag per-customer.

Alex: Yup.
